Do not copy reference hay cart, ditch, planks or cakes. New place: a mountain road in a rocky cutting just below the tree line. A gap between rock walls gives a view down to a tiny village far below. A few first mountain trees along the upper ridge, warm late afternoon sun and soft cool stone shadows. Lower third is the broad open dusty level road, not a chasm.
